info.title: OptionsAhoy Calculator API
info.summary: Deterministic equity-compensation calculator endpoints. JSON in, JSON out.
info.description: Multi-year equity-compensation optimization engine. Eight free calculators. The ISO exercise optimizer searches its full discretized candidate space and refines the result share by share; its schedule matches a brute-force maximum to the cent on the published tractable case, and its post-termination partial-exercise figure is scanned, so it can land a few shares off the exact optimum. The other calculators run bracket-aware searches or exact computations. Models the relevant federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC: ordinary brackets, long-term capital gains, AMT with credit recovery, FICA, NIIT; state AMT modeled for CA, CO, CT, MN. Unauthenticated, wide-open CORS. Same engine as the in-browser tools at https://optionsahoy.com/tools: the computed figures match, inside a next_steps envelope. Determinism is a side benefit: no randomness and no model inference, so a result is a pure function of the inputs plus the current date. Four tools measure a deadline or holding period from today (amt_iso_optimize, concentration_analyze, equity_funding_plan, rsu_lot_optimize), so those figures move as the date moves; the other four return the same answer on any date. The recommendation is therefore verifiable. The tax math is independently verified: every 2026 federal constant matches its IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 value, federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently-maintained PSL Tax-Calculator (https://github.com/PSLmodels/Tax-Calculator), and state tax reproduces to the cent against OpenTaxSolver (https://opentaxsolver.sourceforge.net/) across CA, NY, NJ, PA, and MA, with the proof fetched live from the production API at https://optionsahoy.com/verification. Empirical justification for using an optimizer rather than letting a chatbot do the math: https://optionsahoy.com/benchmark (live, updated for the latest models) and https://hackernoon.com/but-can-it-do-taxes-though-why-you-shouldnt-trust-chatbots-with-tax-optimization-math

get.description: Returns the API name, version, documentation URL, OpenAPI URL, and the array of endpoints. Cheap, public, no body required.

post.description: Returns a multi-year Incentive Stock Option (ISO) exercise schedule that maximizes after-tax Net Final Value (NFV) while minimizing federal and state Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) across the horizon, accounting for AMT credit recovery in later years, qualifying-disposition timing, grant expiration, and the post-termination exercise window. The optimizer searches its full discretized candidate space and refines the result share by share, matching a brute-force maximum to the cent on the published tractable case. Its post-termination partial-exercise figure is scanned, so it can land a few shares off the exact optimum. Timing fields are measured from the current date.

Computes the after-tax payout on a non-qualified stock option (NSO) exercise: federal, state, FICA (Social Security + Medicare + Additional Medicare). Compares selling at exercise vs. holding for long-term capital gains across the chosen horizon.

Compares the after-tax payout from selling RSU shares at vest and reinvesting in the market versus holding the shares, including the 12-month short-term-vs-long-term-capital-gains cliff, state tax, FICA, and the optional growth assumption.
Quantifies single-stock concentration risk: drawdown exposure at 30/50/70% scenarios and the after-tax comparison of selling down vs. holding vs. hedging, with multi-year tax math.

post.summary: Protective put, zero-cost collar, and put-spread pricing
post.description: Prices a protective put, a zero-cost collar, and a put spread on a single-stock position. Reports annual cost, maximum loss, upside cap (collar), protected band (put spread), and bad-year coverage, plus which structure it recommends.

Evaluates Section 1202 Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) against the six statutory tests, returning the verdict, exclusion percentage, federal tax saved, and state conformity under OBBBA 2026 tiered exclusion rules.

post.summary: Multi-plan equity-funding comparison: Lock-in-now / Balanced / Hold-for-growth / Recommended
post.description: Returns four named plans on the risk/wealth frontier plus the full hybrid frontier. It searches for the optimum through a bracket-aware sweep over sale years, months, and lots, and the schedule is measured from the current date; lognormal price exposure drives the shortfall probability; after-tax retained-share value acts as a backstop in the shortfall calculation. The `recommended` plan is the wealth-maximal plan whose shortfall is at or below `riskToleranceShortfall` (default 0.10). Wealth-at-target is compared apples-to-apples on after-tax basis (cash netted plus after-tax retained-share value, both compounded at the after-tax cash-interest rate).

post.summary: RSU lot-order divest plan: which lots to sell, on which dates, at the lowest computed tax
post.description: Given vested RSU lots (vest date, shares, cost basis), a current price, and a divest fraction, chooses which lots and which sale dates minimize total tax to divest the target share count. Three levers: specific-lot identification, long-term deferral, and multi-year bracket spreading with in-plan capital-loss carryforward. Flat-price assumption (no growth model). Returns the year-by-year sell schedule, total tax (federal LTCG + NIIT + state), the saving versus a first-in-first-out (FIFO) sell order on the same schedule, a 1/2/3-year horizon trade-off, and per-lot deferral callouts.

get.description: Returns total tool calls, last 24h / 7d / 30d counts, the top 5 most-called tools, and the timestamp of the most recent call. PII-safe (no IPs, user agents, or arguments). Cached 60 seconds at the edge.

Returns the shields.io endpoint-badge JSON (schemaVersion 1) for live MCP usage. Used by README badges; rendered via https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=. PII-safe aggregate counts only. Cached 5 minutes at the edge. Always returns 200 (lightgrey n/a badge when the stats binding is unconfigured) so the badge keeps rendering.

StateCode.description: Two-letter United States state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX).

Ticker.description: Optional public-stock symbol (e.g. "NVDA"). When set, the API substitutes the ticker's trailing CAGR for any unsupplied expected-return / sale-price field instead of requiring the caller to invent one. ~90 symbols covered; unknown tickers fall through to 'required field' 400 errors.

shares.description: Total ISO shares to exercise across the horizon.

fmv.description: Fair market value per share today (year 1).

expectedGrowth.description: Arithmetic-mean annual growth rate, e.g. 0.10 for 10%/year. Required unless `ticker` resolves it from trailing CAGR. Also accepts the string "market" to use the S&P 500 trailing average when the user has no view.

volatilityDrag.description: Multiplicative haircut at the planning horizon. Either this OR `volatility` is required; if both are supplied, `volatilityDrag` wins.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility (sigma) of the stock. Either this OR `volatilityDrag` is required; if both are supplied, `volatilityDrag` wins. Derived drag = 1 - exp(-(sigma^2 / 2) * horizon).

ordinaryIncome.description: Annual ordinary income excluding the exercise. Taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: no standard or itemized deduction is applied.

carryforwardCredit.description: Existing federal AMT credit from prior years. Optional; defaults to 0 (most first-time exercisers have none).

cashReturnRate.description: Annual after-tax return on idle cash, used to time-value AMT premiums. Optional; defaults to 0.04 when omitted.

grantDate.description: ISO grant date. Drives the 10-year expiration and 2-year qualifying-disposition gate.

terminationDate.description: Termination date if departed; null otherwise. When set, opens the 90-day post-termination exercise window.

holdYears.description: Hold horizon. Sub-1-year is short-term and out of scope.

expectedSalePrice.description: Expected sale price at horizon, USD per share. Required unless `ticker` resolves it from currentPrice × (1 + trailing CAGR)^holdYears. Also accepts the string "market" to project currentPrice at the S&P 500 trailing average.

haircut.description: Volatility-drag haircut on expectedSalePrice. Either this OR `volatility` is required; if both are supplied, `haircut` wins.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility (sigma). Either this OR `haircut` is required; if both are supplied, `haircut` wins. Derived haircut = 1 - exp(-(sigma^2 / 2) * holdYears).

expectedMarketReturn.description: Per-year median market return rate (vol-drag pre-applied). Defaults to SPY trailing CAGR for holdYears if omitted. The string "market" names that same default explicitly.

expectedSalePrice.description: Projected $/share at end of holdYears. Required unless `ticker` resolves it from currentPrice × (1 + trailing CAGR)^holdYears. Also accepts the string "market" to project currentPrice at the S&P 500 trailing average.

haircut.description: Volatility-drag haircut on expectedSalePrice. Either this OR `volatility` is required; if both are supplied, `haircut` wins.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility (sigma). Either this OR `haircut` is required; if both are supplied, `haircut` wins. Derived haircut = 1 - exp(-(sigma^2 / 2) * holdYears).

expectedMarketReturn.description: Per-year reinvestment rate. Defaults to SPY trailing CAGR for holdYears if omitted. The string "market" names that same default explicitly.

positionValue.description: Current value of the concentrated position, USD.

totalAssets.description: Total investable portfolio in dollars (concentrated position + everything else). User-supplied; never inferred.

expectedPositionReturn.description: Annual return on the concentrated stock. Required unless `ticker` resolves it from trailing CAGR. Also accepts the string "market" to use the S&P 500 trailing average when the user has no view.

expectedMarketReturn.description: Annual return on diversified holdings + reinvested proceeds. Defaults to SPY trailing CAGR for the 3-year horizon if omitted. The string "market" names that same default explicitly.

volatilityDrag.description: Multiplicative haircut on the 3y stock-price path. Either this OR `volatility` is required for drag; if both are supplied, `volatilityDrag` wins.

volatility.description: Annualized volatility (sigma). Used for the closed-form option pricing hedging path AND, when `volatilityDrag` is omitted, derives drag = 1 - exp(-(sigma^2 / 2) * 3). Either this OR `volatilityDrag` is required for drag.
Annualized implied volatility (σ). Defaults to a sector-typical implied volatility when omitted.

protectionLevel.description: Drawdown the put protects against, as a fraction (e.g. 0.20 = 20% below current).

spreadRiskLevel.description: Put spread floor breach risk: target probability the stock ends below the spread's short strike. Presets 0.20 / 0.10 / 0.05 / 0.01; off-preset values snap to the nearest. Affects only the putSpread block. Default 0.10.

ticker.description: Optional public-stock symbol to derive implied volatility (e.g. "AAPL").

EquityFundingInput.description: Either `stacks` (v1.7+ multi-stack) OR legacy top-level `lots` + `currentPrice` (single-stack) must be provided.

stacks.description: v1.7+ multi-stack input. Each stack is one ticker.

ticker.description: Optional ticker label. When set without `expectedAnnualGrowth`, the server resolves growth from the trailing-CAGR table.

expectedAnnualGrowth.description: Per-stack growth decimal (0.08 = 8%/yr), or the string "market" for the S&P 500 trailing average. Required unless `ticker` resolves it; omitting it is an error, not a flat default. Pass 0 for a deliberately flat-price plan.

volatility.description: Per-stack annualized σ. Overrides `defaultVolatility` for this stack.

vestDate.description: Optional. Future vest date for unvested RSU tranches; excluded from sales whose date precedes this.

lots.description: Legacy single-stack input (v1.5 / v1.6). Pair with top-level currentPrice.

expectedAnnualGrowth.description: Legacy single-stack annual growth decimal, or the string "market" for the S&P 500 trailing average. Required with legacy `lots`: pass 0 for a deliberately flat-price plan (omitting it is an error, not a flat default).

cashInterestRate.description: Annualized pre-tax yield on cash held between each sale and the target date. The server compounds at the after-tax marginal rate. Defaults to 0.

riskToleranceShortfall.description: Max acceptable P(realized cash < target) under the lognormal price model. The `recommended` plan is the wealth-maximal plan whose shortfall is at or below this value. Default 0.10.

defaultVolatility.description: Annualized σ used for stacks that omit their own `volatility`. Default 0.30.

RsuLotOptimizeInput.description: Vested RSU lots + a divest fraction. Chooses which lots to sell on which dates to divest the target share count at the lowest computed tax.

lots.description: Vested RSU lots you still hold, one per vest tranche. At most 20 per call, the same cap the web calculator uses. Combine tranches sharing a vest date and cost basis.

shares.description: Shares still held from this vest. Fractional allowed.

costBasisPerShare.description: Per-share cost basis, USD (the share price on vest day).

currentPrice.description: Current share price, USD. Every sale is priced at this value (flat-price assumption).

divestFraction.description: Fraction of total shares to divest, as a decimal (0.5 = sell half). Range 0.10 to 1.0.

horizonYears.description: Tax years the plan may span: 1 (sell all now), 2, or 3.

ordinaryIncome.description: Total household ordinary income for the year, USD. Taxable income after deductions, not gross wages: no standard or itemized deduction is applied. Sets the LTCG bracket floor, short-term rate, and NIIT threshold.

AmtIsoResult.description: ISO/AMT exercise optimization result. All dollar amounts are USD.

crossoverShares.description: Maximum whole shares exercisable in year 1 before federal AMT exceeds regular tax (the AMT crossover).

crossoverBargain.description: Bargain element in dollars at the crossover share count: crossoverShares x (fmv - strike).

alreadyInAmt.description: True when the user owes AMT even with zero exercise (regular tax below tentative minimum tax at baseline income).

schedules.description: The three candidate exercise schedules, each evaluated at the effective horizon. Their nfv values are directly comparable; optimized is the highest-NFV schedule the optimizer found.

y0OutflowLtcgTotal.description: Total capital gains tax in dollars on the forgone market gain (cash funding only).

y0OutflowForgoneNet.description: After-tax market growth forgone in dollars by spending cash at exercise: y0OutflowGain - y0OutflowLtcgTotal.

netAtYearN.description: Net after-tax value of the hold strategy in dollars at end of holdYears (after subtracting forgone market growth).

sellNowInvest.description: Counterfactual: sell every share at exercise and reinvest the net cash at expectedMarketReturn for holdYears.

netCashAtY0.description: Net cash in dollars after exercise tax, available to reinvest.

marketGain.description: Market growth in dollars on the reinvested cash over holdYears.

ltcgFederal.description: Federal capital gains tax (including NIIT) in dollars on the market gain at the horizon.

ltcgState.description: State capital gains tax in dollars on the market gain.

ltcgTotal.description: Total capital gains tax in dollars on the market gain.

netAtYearN.description: Net after-tax value of sell-now-and-invest in dollars at end of holdYears.

holdMinusCashless.description: hold.netAtYearN - sellNowInvest.netAtYearN in dollars. Positive favors holding the shares; negative favors selling at exercise and reinvesting.

RsuResult.description: RSU sell-at-vest vs hold result. All dollar amounts are USD.

vest.description: Tax bill at vest on the full vest value (taxed as ordinary W-2 income).

vestValue.description: shares x currentPrice in dollars, taxed as ordinary income at vest.

federal.description: True federal ordinary income tax on the vest value in dollars (marginal bracket, not the withholding).

state.description: State income tax on the vest value in dollars.

socialSecurity.description: Social Security tax in dollars (0 when not employed or already past the wage base).

total.description: Total tax at vest in dollars.

netCashAtVest.description: vestValue - total: net cash in dollars if every share is sold at vest.

federalWithheldAtVest.description: Mandatory federal supplemental withholding in dollars (22% on the first $1M of supplemental wages, 37% above). When less than vest.federal, the difference is owed at tax time.

bracketJump.description: Marginal federal bracket change caused by the new ordinary income; null when the income stays within one bracket.

fromRate.description: Marginal federal rate before the event, as a decimal (0.24 = 24%).

toRate.description: Marginal federal rate after the event, as a decimal.

thresholdAtJump.description: Taxable-income threshold in dollars where the bracket changes.

hold.description: Keep the after-tax shares for holdYears, then sell.

costBasis.description: Cost basis per share in dollars (FMV at vest).

effectiveSalePrice.description: Projected sale price per share in dollars at end of holdYears, after the volatility haircut.

sharesRetained.description: Shares kept after the sell-to-cover dollar-equivalent of the vest tax.

expectedGain.description: Expected capital gain in dollars on the retained shares: (effectiveSalePrice - costBasis) x sharesRetained.

capGainFederal.description: Federal capital gains tax in dollars on the gain: LTCG (including NIIT) when isLongTerm, else the marginal ordinary rate.

capGainState.description: State capital gains tax in dollars on the gain.

capGainTotal.description: Total capital gains tax in dollars at sale.

isLongTerm.description: True when holdYears >= 1, so appreciation gets long-term capital gains treatment.

netAtYearN.description: Net after-tax value of holding in dollars at end of holdYears: sale proceeds - capGainTotal.

sellNowInvest.description: Counterfactual: sell every share at vest and reinvest the net cash at expectedMarketReturn for holdYears.

netCashAtY0.description: Net cash in dollars at vest available to reinvest (equals vest.netCashAtVest).

marketGain.description: Market growth in dollars on the reinvested cash over holdYears.

capGainFederal.description: Federal capital gains tax in dollars on the market gain: LTCG (including NIIT) when isLongTerm, else the marginal ordinary rate.

capGainState.description: State capital gains tax in dollars on the market gain.

capGainTotal.description: Total capital gains tax in dollars on the market gain.

netAtYearN.description: Net after-tax value of sell-at-vest-and-invest in dollars at end of holdYears.

holdMinusSell.description: hold.netAtYearN - sellNowInvest.netAtYearN in dollars. Positive favors holding the vested shares; negative favors selling at vest and reinvesting.

ConcentrationResult.description: Single-stock concentration analysis. All dollar amounts are USD.

riskBand.description: Qualitative concentration band for the position weight.

isLongTermToday.description: True when the position already qualifies for long-term capital gains treatment.

longTermDate.description: Date the position turns long-term (acquisitionDate + 1 year). ISO 8601 date-time string.

daysUntilLongTerm.description: Days until long-term treatment; 0 when already long-term.

drop.description: Modeled drawdown as a fraction of position value (0.30, 0.50, 0.70).

waitForLtInsight.description: Tax saved by waiting for long-term treatment before selling; null when already long-term or no sale is needed.

longTermDate.description: Date the position turns long-term. ISO 8601 date-time string.

immediateLumpSumTax.description: Tax in dollars on the full sell-down executed today (short-term rates).

delayedLumpSumTax.description: Tax in dollars on the same sale executed after the long-term date.

schedule.description: Sell-down plans over 1, 2, and 3 years; empty when the position is already at or below the target weight.

planLabel.description: Human-readable plan name, e.g. "Sell over 2 years".

yearlySales.description: One entry per sale year: year (1-indexed), saleAmount, gainAmount, isLongTerm, federalTax, stateTax, totalTax in dollars, plus a per-slice breakdown.

gainAmount.description: Taxable gain in dollars within the sale.

isLongTerm.description: True when this sale gets long-term capital gains treatment.

federalTax.description: Federal tax in dollars on this sale (including NIIT).

stateTax.description: State tax in dollars on this sale.

totalTax.description: Total tax in dollars on this sale.

items.description: One tax slice: a dollar amount taxed at one rate.

rate.description: Rate applied to this slice as a decimal (0.15 = 15%).

amount.description: Dollars of gain in this slice.

tax.description: Tax in dollars: amount x rate.

breakdown.description: Per-rate tax slices for this sale.

totalSale.description: Total nominal sale dollars across the plan years.

totalTax.description: Total tax in dollars across the plan years.

endOfHorizonWealth.description: Total after-tax wealth in dollars at the end of the 3-year comparison horizon.

savingsVsLumpSum.description: Raw tax saved in dollars vs selling everything today; positive means this plan pays less tax.

wealthVsLumpSum.description: End-of-horizon wealth delta in dollars vs the sell-everything-today baseline; positive means this plan ends wealthier.

year1IsShortTerm.description: True when the first sale year would be taxed at short-term rates.

items.description: One tax slice: a dollar amount taxed at one rate.

rate.description: Rate applied to this slice as a decimal (0.15 = 15%).

amount.description: Dollars of gain in this slice.

tax.description: Tax in dollars: amount x rate.

taxBreakdown.description: Plan-total tax slices, same-rate rows merged.

wealthByYear.description: Total wealth in dollars at the end of each year, t = 0..3 (4 points). For charting.

hedging.description: Modeled cost of a protective hedge covering the full position. Defaults to a 1-year 30%-OTM put; if a `hedgeChoice` is supplied, this block prices that structure (kind / protectionLevel / tenorYears, plus a short call for a collar).

kind.description: Structure priced: "put" (default) or "collar" when a hedgeChoice with kind:"collar" and upsideCapPct was supplied.

protectionLevel.description: Floor as a fraction below spot (0.30 = a 30%-OTM put). Echoes hedgeChoice.protectionLevel, else 0.30.

tenorYears.description: Hedge tenor in years. Echoes hedgeChoice.tenorYears, else 1.

strike.description: Long put strike in dollars ((1 - protectionLevel) x position value).

putPrice.description: Gross long-put premium in dollars for the tenor.

callStrike.description: Collar short-call strike in dollars ((1 + upsideCapPct) x position value). Omitted for a put.

callPrice.description: Collar short-call premium in dollars received. Omitted for a put.

netPremium.description: Net premium paid in dollars: putPrice for a put, max(0, putPrice - callPrice) for a collar.

sigma.description: Annualized volatility used in pricing (explicit or ticker-implied vol, else a sector-typical implied volatility).

riskFreeRate.description: Annualized risk-free rate used in pricing, as a decimal.

sectorContextLine.description: One-line volatility/drawdown context for the chosen sector.

advisorBenchmarkLine.description: One-line comparison of the user weight vs the common advisor 10% single-name guideline.

ProtectivePutResult.description: Protective put, zero-cost collar, and put-spread pricing on a single-stock position. All dollar amounts are USD.

inputs.description: Echo of the resolved inputs actually priced: positionValue, sector, volatility (the sigma used after ticker/sector resolution), protectionLevel, tenorYears, plus expectedReturn, spreadRiskLevel, and tickerLabel when supplied.

volatility.description: Annualized sigma actually used in pricing, as a decimal.

protectionLevel.description: Protection level as a fraction below spot (0.10 = 10% OTM put).

expectedReturn.description: Caller-supplied annual expected return used for probability metrics. Omitted when not supplied.

spreadRiskLevel.description: Put spread floor breach risk echoed from the request (snapped to a supported preset). Omitted when not supplied.

tickerLabel.description: Display label echoed from the request (ticker or tickerLabel). Omitted when not supplied.

riskFreeRate.description: Annualized risk-free rate used in option pricing, looked up for the tenor, as a decimal.

realWorldDrift.description: Annual real-world drift used for the probability metrics: expectedReturn when supplied, else the sector long-run return. Does not affect premium math.

barePut.description: Bare protective put: pay premium for a hard floor.

strike.description: Put strike in dollars: (1 - protectionLevel) x position value.

premium.description: Put premium in dollars for the full tenor.

annualCost.description: Premium annualized, in dollars per year.

annualCostPct.description: Annualized premium as a fraction of position value.

maxLoss.description: Worst-case loss in dollars with the put in place: position - strike + premium.

badYearPrice.description: Position value in dollars at the 10th-percentile (1-in-10 bad year) outcome under real-world drift.

badYearDropPct.description: Bad-year drawdown as a fraction of position value (always >= 0).

coveredLossAtBadYear.description: Dollars the put pays at the bad-year price; 0 when the bad-year drop never reaches the protection floor.

premiumToCoveredRatio.description: Premium per dollar of bad-year coverage. null (serialized from Infinity) when the put covers nothing at the bad-year price; above ~0.40 the floor is set too deep.

expectedProfit.description: Expected position profit in dollars over the tenor under real-world drift.

premiumToExpectedProfitRatio.description: Fraction of typical-period expected profit consumed by the premium. null (serialized from Infinity) when expected profit is zero or negative; above ~0.50 the hedge eats most of the upside.

collar.description: Put financed by a short call: lower or zero net premium in exchange for capped upside.

putStrike.description: Long put strike in dollars (same floor as the bare put).

callStrike.description: Short call strike in dollars (the upside cap level).

netPremium.description: Net premium in dollars: put premium - call premium, floored at 0.

annualCost.description: Net premium annualized, in dollars per year.

annualCostPct.description: Annualized net premium as a fraction of position value.

maxLoss.description: Worst-case loss in dollars with the collar in place.

upsideCap.description: Maximum upside in dollars before the short call caps gains: callStrike - position value.

upsideCapPct.description: Maximum upside as a fraction of position value.

isZeroCost.description: True when the solved call strike makes the collar effectively zero net premium.

capProbability.description: Real-world probability (0..1) the stock finishes above the call strike at expiration, i.e. the upside cap binds.

putSpread.description: Put debit spread: long put at the protection floor financed by a short put at a lower strike. Cheaper than the bare put and needs no short call (so it works on unexercised employee options a collar cannot cover), but protection stops at the short strike and losses resume below it. The short strike is solved so the real-world probability the stock ENDS below it equals spreadRiskLevel.

available.description: False when no useful spread exists at these inputs: the 1-in-N short strike lands at/above the floor (floor already deep for this risk level) or the short leg does not reduce cost. When false, the numeric fields of this block are null and unavailableReason carries the explanation in their place.

unavailableReason.description: Why the spread is unavailable; null when available. 'floor' = the solved short strike sits at/above the protection floor (or within 1% of position of it). 'no-rebate' = the short leg does not strictly reduce cost.

longStrike.description: Long put strike in dollars (same floor as the bare put).

longPremium.description: Long put premium in dollars for the full tenor (same as barePut.premium).

shortStrike.description: Short put strike in dollars, solved so P(end below it) = spreadRiskLevel.

shortPremium.description: Short put premium in dollars received for the full tenor.

shortSigma.description: Annualized sigma used to price the short leg, as a decimal (equals volatility in flat-sigma mode).

netPremium.description: Net debit in dollars: long premium - short premium, floored at 0.

annualCost.description: Net premium annualized, in dollars per year.

annualCostPct.description: Annualized net premium as a fraction of position value.

maxLossInBand.description: Loss in dollars if the stock ends anywhere inside the protected band (floor holds): position - longStrike + netPremium. Below the short strike, losses resume dollar-for-dollar on top of this.

bandWidth.description: Width of the protected band in dollars: longStrike - shortStrike (the spread max payout).

shortStrikeDropPct.description: Short strike as a drawdown from spot, as a fraction of position value.

breachProbability.description: Achieved real-world probability (0..1) the stock ends below the short strike; approximately spreadRiskLevel after the solve.

riskLevel.description: The spreadRiskLevel preset the solve targeted (0.20 / 0.10 / 0.05 / 0.01), after snapping.

savingsPct.description: Fraction of the bare put premium rebated by the short leg: shortPremium / longPremium.

coveredLossAtBadYear.description: Dollars the spread pays at the bad-year price, capped at bandWidth; 0 when the bad-year drop never reaches the floor.

payoffTable.description: Terminal P&L in dollars at each 10%-step drawdown across payoffRange, for the bare put, the collar, the put spread, and the unhedged position.

drawdownPct.description: Price move as a fraction of spot (-0.30 = down 30%, 0.2 = up 20%).

barePutPnl.description: Position + put P&L in dollars at this move.

collarPnl.description: Position + collar P&L in dollars at this move.

spreadPnl.description: Position + put-spread P&L in dollars at this move. null (serialized from NaN) when putSpread.available is false.

unhedgedPnl.description: Unhedged position P&L in dollars at this move.

payoffRange.description: Price-move range covered by payoffTable, extended at least 15% beyond each collar arm and at least +/-50%.

lowerPct.description: Lower bound of the modeled price move, as a fraction of spot (negative).

upperPct.description: Upper bound of the modeled price move, as a fraction of spot.

recommended.description: Suggested structure, in triage order: collar unless its cap binds too often (>20% probability); then protective-put unless the put is expensive; then put-spread when one is available and cleanly priced (cheaper by construction); none when nothing is clean. The recommended structure is the one whose card carries no warning.

QsbsResult.description: Section 1202 QSBS qualification result. All dollar amounts are USD.

verdict.description: Overall verdict. "partial" = qualifies but at a sub-100% exclusion tier (e.g. an OBBBA 3- or 4-year hold gives 50% or 75%). "caveats" = qualifies, but one or more tests returned "unsure" (pass conditional on facts the caller marked unknown). "too-soon" = the holding period has not reached any exclusion tier yet.

exclusionPercent.description: Fraction of the capped gain excludable from federal tax, per the era and holding-period tier.

perIssuerCap.description: Statutory per-issuer cap in dollars: $10M pre-OBBBA, $15M for stock acquired after July 4, 2025.

applicableCap.description: max(perIssuerCap, tenXBasisCap): the exclusion cap actually applied, in dollars.

excludableGain.description: Portion of expectedGain excludable from federal tax in dollars.

taxableGain.description: Portion of expectedGain still federally taxable in dollars (overage above the cap plus any non-excluded fraction).

federalTaxSaved.description: Federal LTCG tax (including NIIT) avoided on the excluded gain, in dollars.

stateConforms.description: Whether the user state conforms to the federal 1202 exclusion.

stateNote.description: Per-state conformity explanation. May be omitted.

cappedOverageNote.description: Present only when expectedGain exceeds applicableCap and an exclusion is in play: explains that the overage is fully taxable regardless of holding period and that spreading shares across separate taxpayers (e.g. non-grantor trusts) can multiply the per-issuer exclusion. Omitted otherwise.

holdingYears.description: Calendar-aware years between acquisitionDate and saleDate.

yearsUntilFullExclusion.description: Additional years to hold before reaching the 100% exclusion tier; 0 when already reached.

era.description: Acquisition-era classification that sets the exclusion schedule (50% pre-2009 era, 75% pre-2010 era, 100% at 5y pre-OBBBA, tiered 50/75/100% at 3/4/5y under OBBBA).

tests.description: The six statutory tests with per-test status, identifying any gate that failed.

status.description: "wait" means the test will pass with more holding time.

detail.description: One-line explanation of the test outcome.

EquityFundingResult.description: Equity-funding plan comparison: four named plans plus the full risk/wealth frontier. All dollar amounts are USD.

recommended.description: The wealth-maximal plan whose shortfall probability is at or below the applied risk tolerance. This is the plan the risk tolerance selects out of the frontier.

planKey.description: Plan identifier. "candidate" entries appear only inside frontier.

plan.description: The full sale schedule for this plan. Nested year/sale entries follow the shapes described here and may carry additional fields.

feasible.description: True when the schedule reaches the after-tax target by the target date.

targetAfterTax.description: Echo of the requested net cash target in dollars.

targetDateISO.description: Echo of the target date as an ISO date string.

totalAfterTaxAchieved.description: Net after-tax cash in dollars the schedule produces by the target date (including after-tax cash interest when cashInterestRate is set).

totalSharesSold.description: Total shares sold across the schedule.

totalGrossProceeds.description: Total gross sale proceeds in dollars.

totalTaxes.description: Tax totals across all scheduled sales, in dollars.

federal.description: Federal capital gains / ordinary tax in dollars.

niit.description: Net Investment Income Tax (3.8%) in dollars.

schedule.description: Per-year sale schedule. Each entry: year, saleDateISO, sales (array of per-lot entries: stackIndex, ticker, lotIndex, shares, grossProceeds, gainAmount, isLongTerm, federalTax, stateTax, niit, netCash), yearGrossProceeds, yearTotalTax, yearNetCash, runningCumulativeNet.

comparison.description: This schedule vs the naive sell-everything-in-the-target-year alternative.

sellAllInTargetYearTotalTax.description: Tax in dollars if all needed shares were sold in the target year.

sellAllInTargetYearAfterTax.description: After-tax cash in dollars under that naive plan.

optimizedSavingsVsTargetYearSale.description: Tax saved in dollars by this schedule vs the naive plan.

optimizedSavingsPct.description: Tax saved as a fraction of the naive plan tax.

remainingShares.description: Shares retained after all scheduled sales.

remainingPositionValue.description: Market value in dollars of retained shares at the projected target-date price.

remainingPositionAfterTax.description: After-tax value in dollars of liquidating all retained shares at the target date (the cash backstop if scheduled sales come in light).

remainingNetByStack.description: Per-stack after-tax retained value in dollars, parallel to the input stacks array.

shortfall.description: Present only when the target is not reachable from the available inventory.

schedule.description: Per-year sale schedule. Each entry: year, saleDateISO, sales (array of per-lot entries: stackIndex, ticker, lotIndex, shares, grossProceeds, gainAmount, isLongTerm, federalTax, stateTax, niit, netCash), yearGrossProceeds, yearTotalTax, yearNetCash, runningCumulativeNet.

comparison.description: This schedule vs the naive sell-everything-in-the-target-year alternative.

sellAllInTargetYearTotalTax.description: Tax in dollars if all needed shares were sold in the target year.

sellAllInTargetYearAfterTax.description: After-tax cash in dollars under that naive plan.

optimizedSavingsVsTargetYearSale.description: Tax saved in dollars by this schedule vs the naive plan.

optimizedSavingsPct.description: Tax saved as a fraction of the naive plan tax.

remainingShares.description: Shares retained after all scheduled sales.

remainingPositionValue.description: Market value in dollars of retained shares at the projected target-date price.

remainingPositionAfterTax.description: After-tax value in dollars of liquidating all retained shares at the target date (the cash backstop if scheduled sales come in light).

remainingNetByStack.description: Per-stack after-tax retained value in dollars, parallel to the input stacks array.

shortfall.description: Present only when the target is not reachable from the available inventory.

maxAchievableAfterTax.description: Maximum after-tax cash in dollars achievable by the target date.

wealthAtTarget.description: Total wealth in dollars at the target date: net cash plus retained shares at the projected price. The metric the recommendation maximizes.

totalTax.description: Total tax paid across the plan in dollars.

shortfallProbability.description: Lognormal probability (0..1) that realized cash lands below the target. 0 means a deterministic hit (sell everything today).

lockInFraction.description: Fraction (0..1) of the target locked in by an immediate sale, for hybrid candidates. Omitted on pure named plans.

frontier.description: All candidate plans from the hybrid lock-in sweep plus the named plans, sorted by shortfall probability.

targetAfterTax.description: Echo of the requested net cash target in dollars.

targetDateISO.description: Echo of the target date as an ISO date string.

appliedRiskTolerance.description: Shortfall-probability tolerance actually applied (default 0.10 when not supplied).

RsuLotOptimizeResult.description: RSU lot-order divest plan: which lots to sell on which dates to divest the target share count at the lowest total tax, versus a first-in-first-out (FIFO) sell order. All dollar amounts are USD.

sharesToSell.description: Shares the plan divests (round(divestFraction x totalShares), floored at 1).

totalShares.description: Total shares across all input lots.

totalGross.description: Gross proceeds from the divested shares, in dollars.

totalTax.description: Total plan tax across all years (federal LTCG + NIIT + state, net of in-plan loss carryforward), in dollars.

totalAfterTax.description: After-tax proceeds from the divested shares, in dollars.

items.description: All sales in one tax year, after Schedule D netting.
One vested lot sold, in whole or part, on one date.

lotIndex.description: 0-based index into the input lots array this row draws from.

vestDate.description: Vest (acquisition) date of the lot, ISO date-time string.

saleDate.description: Date this block is sold, ISO date-time string: today, a long-term-crossing date, or Jan 2 of a later plan year.

year.description: Calendar tax year of the sale.

shares.description: Shares sold in this row (may be fractional).

grossProceeds.description: Gross sale proceeds in dollars (shares x current price; flat-price assumption).

gainAmount.description: Realized capital gain, negative for a loss, in dollars.

isLongTerm.description: True when the lot was held more than one year at the sale date (long-term capital gain).

taxAttributed.description: Signed tax attributed to this row in dollars; a loss row is negative (the tax it removes).

sales.description: Per-lot sale rows in this year.

netLong.description: Net long-term gain or loss after netting, in dollars.

netShort.description: Net short-term gain or loss after netting, in dollars.

tax.description: Total tax for this year (federal + state + NIIT), in dollars.

effectiveRate.description: Year tax divided by year net gain, 0..1.

carryforwardGenerated.description: Capital loss carried into the next plan year from this year, in dollars (0 when the year nets positive).

schedule.description: The sell plan, grouped by tax year.

keptUnrealizedGain.description: Unrealized gain still carried by the shares NOT sold, in dollars (deferred, not eliminated).

carryforwardRemaining.description: Capital loss remaining at the end of the plan horizon, in dollars (reported, not modeled into future years).

headlineAfterTaxKept.description: After-tax proceeds under the plan, in dollars: the headline "you keep $X" figure.

headlineDeltaVsFifo.description: Dollars saved versus selling oldest-first (FIFO) on the SAME schedule. Pure lot-selection benefit; >= 0 by construction.

attribution.description: Telescoping attribution of the total saving vs a FIFO-all-today sale. lotSelection + spreadingDeferral = total.

lotSelection.description: Saving from choosing which lots to sell (equals headlineDeltaVsFifo), in dollars.

spreadingDeferral.description: Saving from spreading sales across years and deferring for long-term status, in dollars. Can be <= 0 in loss-mix cases.

total.description: Total saving vs selling oldest-first, all today, in dollars.

items.description: Total tax and after-tax proceeds for the same divest target under a given horizon.

horizonYears.description: Plan length in tax years (1 = sell all now, 2, or 3).

totalTax.description: Total plan tax under this horizon, in dollars.

afterTaxKept.description: After-tax proceeds from the divested shares under this horizon, in dollars.

horizonCards.description: The same divest target under a 1-year ("all now"), 2-year, and 3-year plan, for the trade-off strip.

items.description: A short-term lot that becomes long-term if its sale waits past longTermDate.

lotIndex.description: 0-based index into the input lots array.

longTermDate.description: Date the lot becomes long-term, ISO date-time string (a sale strictly after the first vest anniversary).

daysToWait.description: Days from the planned sale date to longTermDate.

taxSaved.description: Tax saved by waiting for long-term treatment, in dollars.

amountAtRisk.description: Position value kept exposed to the stock while waiting, in dollars.

externalDocs.description: Integration surface, citation guidance, and roadmap
